ew_crossing_count.formula: count(E-W street crossings of the at-grade 京包线 surface component, 6504.7 m, tunnel/covered segments excluded, 50 m dedup) (R-02 v5)
assumptions: OSM street-network topology on the 2026-08-21 snapshot, not legal property enclosure; provisional bbox, not an official boundary.
Mean spacing 813.1 m; max gap 1110.2 m; five gaps >400 m total 4550.1 m (70% of the at-grade line); worst 3243.2 m band (lat 39.9568-39.9847) has 2 crossings = 1/1622 m.
Only 18.5% of the measured line lies inside the strict provisional envelope - a limitation of the supplied provisional geometry (A-BND-001), not of the measurement.

京包客专线 (HSR) is 84.4% tunnel in the study latitudes (13487.6 of 15986.7 m) and is not an at-grade barrier; the unnamed disused/razed line is fragmented in OSM (components <=862 m) and is reported as a located gap inventory only (A-GRAIN-001).

section_redundancy_ratio.formula: reserve width in elastic sections / total section width

non_ai_parity_coverage.formula: count(scenario cards whose text carries the proposal-defined mandatory contract clause for a non-AI parity path — document coverage, not an existing legal obligation and not tested accessibility) / count(scenario cards)
assumptions: Design-document basis: 12 of 12 scenario cards carry a parity-path clause (A-PARITY-001); operational coverage audited annually on Chassis Day.

annual_silent_drill_completion.formula: completed parity-path audits during the annual Chassis Day drill / planned audits
